display.purpose: Short, shouted hero titles on story, Lineup, store, and tournament surfaces.

headline.purpose: Section and result headings with a tightly balanced measure.

title.purpose: Relic names, Move names, offer names, and prominent values.

body.purpose: Readable rules, descriptions, dialogue, and supporting instructions.

label.purpose: Uppercase class, provenance, meter, status, and control metadata.

shadows.name: ticket-lift
shadows.purpose: Standard structural lift beneath removable paper tickets and rails.

shadows.name: rail-lift
shadows.purpose: Shallow separation beneath the sticky application rail.

shadows.name: drawer-channel
shadows.purpose: Paired inset edges that make the battle stage read as an open collector drawer.

shadows.name: result-lift
shadows.purpose: Highest elevation, reserved for the blocking battle result stamp.

motion.name: meter-response
motion.purpose: Keeps health and Charge Strip values responsive without decorative easing.

motion.name: idle-swap
motion.purpose: Alternates paired rectangular idle prints when reduced motion is not active.

motion.name: hit-nudge
motion.purpose: A short directional impact displacement with yoyo return.

motion.name: kinetic-cut-in
motion.purpose: Slams a selected Move print across the full arena and returns it to the drawer.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses CSS transition and animation duration for system or explicit reduced-motion preferences.

components.name: Primary Print Button
components.description: The decisive action label for continuing, fighting, buying, or retrying.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 3.6rem; border: 3px solid var(--ink, #14151a); padding: 0.72rem 1.2rem; background: var(--yellow, #f2d742); color: var(--ink, #14151a); box-shadow: 0.4rem 0.5rem 0.95rem rgb(4 8 22 / 35%); font-family: var(--display, "League Gothic", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--tomato, #ef4d39); color: var(--chalk, #f7f0dd); transform: translate(-1px, -1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--focus, #8de1ff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(0, 0); }

components.name: Secondary Indigo Button
components.description: A quieter boxed action that remains legible against result and content sheets.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 3.4rem; border: 3px solid var(--chalk, #f7f0dd); padding: 0.65rem 1rem; background: var(--indigo, #111f46); color: var(--chalk, #f7f0dd); font-family: var(--body, "Atkinson Hyperlegible", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif); font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--tomato, #ef4d39); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--focus, #8de1ff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Archive Navigation Tab
components.description: An equal-width destination tab with a perforated divider and printed active marker.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; border: 4px solid var(--ink, #14151a); background: var(--chalk, #f7f0dd); } .ds-nav-tab { min-width: 6rem; flex: 1; border: 0; border-right: 2px dashed rgb(20 21 26 / 36%); padding: 0.8rem 0.65rem; background: transparent; color: var(--indigo, #111f46); font-family: var(--body, "Atkinson Hyperlegible", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif); font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-tab:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-nav-tab:hover, .ds-nav-tab.ds-is-active { background: var(--yellow, #f2d742); color: var(--ink, #14151a); } .ds-nav-tab.ds-is-active { box-shadow: inset 0 -0.45rem 0 var(--tomato, #ef4d39); } .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--focus, #8de1ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Registration Field
components.description: A plain paper field held by a hard registration border.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-collector">COLLECTOR NAME</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-collector" value="Collector" />
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; color: var(--ink, #14151a); font-family: var(--body, "Atkinson Hyperlegible", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 2.8rem; border: 3px solid var(--ink, #14151a); border-radius: 0; padding: 0.45rem 0.65rem; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #14151a); font-family: var(--body, "Atkinson Hyperlegible", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif); } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--tomato, #ef4d39); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--focus, #8de1ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Lineup Specimen Ticket
components.description: A roster ticket combining square character art, class, health, and explicit state.
components.css: .ds-lineup-ticket { position: relative; display: grid; width: 18rem; min-height: 5.4rem; grid-template-columns: 4rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0.6rem; align-items: center; border: 3px solid var(--ink, #14151a); padding: 0.35rem; overflow: hidden; background: var(--chalk, #f7f0dd); color: var(--ink, #14151a); text-align: left; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 0.55rem), calc(100% - 0.55rem) 100%, 0 100%); cursor: pointer; } .ds-lineup-ticket:hover { background: var(--yellow, #f2d742); transform: translateX(0.2rem); } .ds-lineup-ticket:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--focus, #8de1ff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-lineup-art { display: grid; width: 4rem; height: 4rem; place-items: center; background: var(--indigo, #111f46); color: var(--chalk, #f7f0dd); font-family: var(--display, "League Gothic", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size: 2.5rem; } .ds-lineup-copy { display: grid; font-family: var(--body, "Atkinson Hyperlegible", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif); } .ds-lineup-copy strong { font-size: 1rem; } .ds-lineup-copy small { font-size: 0.72rem; } .ds-lineup-state { position: absolute; right: -1.6rem; bottom: 0.45rem; width: 6rem; background: var(--indigo, #111f46); color: var(--chalk, #f7f0dd); font-size: 0.62rem; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; transform: rotate(-38deg); }

components.name: Move Label
components.description: One of three equally prominent battle actions with position, prediction, cost, and timing.
components.css: .ds-move { display: grid; width: 28rem; min-height: 7.5rem; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 0.7rem; align-items: center; border: 4px solid var(--ink, #14151a); padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem; background: var(--yellow, #f2d742); color: var(--ink, #14151a); box-shadow: 0.55rem 0.7rem 1.25rem rgb(4 8 22 / 35%); text-align: left; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 0.65rem), calc(100% - 0.65rem) 100%, 0 100%); cursor: pointer; } .ds-move:hover { transform: translateY(-0.22rem) rotate(-0.25deg); } .ds-move:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--focus, #8de1ff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-move-position { display: grid; width: 2.6rem; height: 3.7rem; place-items: center; border: 3px solid currentColor; font-family: var(--display, "League Gothic", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size: 2rem; } .ds-move-copy { display: grid; gap: 0.2rem; } .ds-move-copy strong { font-family: var(--display, "League Gothic", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size: 2.4rem; line-height: 0.95; } .ds-move-copy small { font-family: var(--body, "Atkinson Hyperlegible", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif); } .ds-move-number { display: grid; min-width: 3rem; justify-items: center; border: 3px solid currentColor; padding: 0.2rem; font-family: var(--display, "League Gothic", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size: 1.6rem; } .ds-move-number small { font-family: var(--body, "Atkinson Hyperlegible", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif); font-size: 0.55rem; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Health and Charge Strips
components.description: Compact labelled bars that pair values with colour-coded transform fills.
components.html:
HEALTH118 / 160
CHARGE62 / 100
components.css: .ds-strips { width: 18rem; padding: 0.55rem; border: 3px solid var(--ink, #14151a); background: rgb(247 240 221 / 94%); color: var(--ink, #14151a); font-family: var(--body, "Atkinson Hyperlegible", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif); } .ds-meter-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 0.4rem; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-meter { height: 0.7rem; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #14151a); overflow: hidden; background: var(--indigo-deep, #091128); } .ds-meter span { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: var(--tomato, #ef4d39); transform: scaleX(var(--ds-fill, 0)); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform 80ms linear; } .ds-meter.ds-charge span { background: var(--yellow, #f2d742); }

components.name: Status Stamp
components.description: An outlined text label for battle status that never relies on colour alone.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-block; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #14151a); padding: 0.06rem 0.35rem; background: var(--chalk, #f7f0dd); color: var(--ink, #14151a); font-family: var(--body, "Atkinson Hyperlegible", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif); font-size: 0.62rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status:hover { background: var(--yellow, #f2d742); } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid var(--focus, #8de1ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Battle Result Stamp
components.description: The blocking, highest-elevation verdict sheet shown after a fight.
components.css: .ds-result { width: min(38rem, 100%); border: 6px solid var(--ink, #14151a); padding: 2rem; overflow: hidden; background: var(--yellow, #f2d742); color: var(--ink, #14151a); box-shadow: 0.8rem 1rem 2rem rgb(0 0 0 / 50%); transform: rotate(-0.6deg); font-family: var(--body, "Atkinson Hyperlegible", ui-sans-serif, sans-serif); } .ds-result > span { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-result h2 { max-width: 10ch; margin: 0.8rem 0; font-family: var(--display, "League Gothic", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size: 4rem; line-height: 0.88; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-result dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); margin: 0; border: 4px solid currentColor; } .ds-result dl div { display: grid; padding: 0.65rem; border-right: 3px dashed currentColor; } .ds-result dl div:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-result dt { font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-result dd { margin: 0; font-family: var(--display, "League Gothic", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif); font-size: 2.4rem; }

narrative.overview:
Riot Relics feels like a pulled-open collector drawer full of underground fight bills, specimen labels, scuffed toys, and hand-stamped results. It is tactile, dense, irreverent, and immediately playable: the interface behaves like a physical archive being sorted under pressure, never like a floating sci-fi HUD.

The visual world uses a constrained risograph palette, blunt display type, torn seams, clipped paper corners, halftone texture, and square pull-tabs. Static rectangular character art becomes kinetic through two-frame swaps, panel translation, cut-ins, hit-stop, shake, flashes, and stamped feedback. The durable interaction story is story node → Lineup → Charge Strip → Stamps → next print.
keyCharacteristics: Pulled-open drawer composition with compact rails and strict trays.
Indigo board, tomato and acid-yellow spot inks, chalk stock, and near-black registration ink.
Rectangular Kinetic Print art with halftone wear and purposeful misregistration.
Square, bordered controls with torn or clipped paper edges; circles are reserved for holes and stamps.
Large condensed uppercase display type paired with highly legible body copy.
Short, forceful motion that always has a reduced-motion equivalent.

rules.name: The Spot-Ink Rule
rules.body: Tomato and acid yellow signal action or state; do not spend them as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Registration Rule
rules.body: Light paper objects are held together by visible near-black borders, seams, or dividers.

rules.name: The Cyan Exception Rule
rules.body: Focus cyan belongs to keyboard focus only and must not become a general accent.

rules.name: The Shout-and-Explain Rule
rules.body: League Gothic names the thing; Atkinson Hyperlegible explains what it does.

rules.name: The Short Display Rule
rules.body: Display copy stays brief and balanced—headlines are labels, not paragraphs.

rules.name: The Arena-First Rule
rules.body: Compress labels and secondary metadata before reducing the central art stage below a usable decision surface.

rules.name: The Three-Move Rule
rules.body: All three Moves remain equally prominent; no action receives a privileged hero-card slot.

rules.name: The Printed-Object Rule
rules.body: A shadow represents a physical label or drawer layer, never a generic floating panel.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: Tonal opacity may support legibility over art, but blur, glow, and glassmorphism do not belong in this world.

rules.name: The Square-First Rule
rules.body: Start every surface at zero radius; earn a circle only when it represents a physical punch, stamp, or control.

rules.name: The Controlled-Crooked Rule
rules.body: Rotation stays subtle on cards and forceful only on explicit stamps; content alignment remains readable.

dos: Do stage play as labelled physical matter: drawers, tickets, specimen wells, pull-tabs, perforations, and stamps.
Do keep the first battle viewport readable as compact rail, Lineups, central arena, paired meters, and three Moves.
Do use rectangular and square art as an intentional Kinetic Print language.
Do pair colour with text, shape, position, or value for every gameplay state.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, touch-sized controls, and the reduced-motion override.
Do use stable logical asset IDs and the approved fallback chain when adding new art.
donts: Don't introduce rounded dashboard cards, pills as default controls, glassmorphism, neon glow, or a sci-fi HUD.
Don't turn tomato or acid yellow into unbounded decoration; they communicate action and state.
Don't obscure the arena with floating panels or let opposing readouts collide with the matchup stamp.
Don't make one Move visually dominant over the other two.
Don't rely on colour alone for class, status, availability, health, or outcome.
Don't add decorative motion without a short purpose and a reduced-motion equivalent.
